items.title: NTE: Neverness to Everness tops $298 million in lifetime revenue, adding almost $98 million in just 1.5 months
items.summary: Publisher Perfect World recently revealed the figures in its financial report for the first half of the fiscal year.
items.content:
Home News NTE: Neverness to Everness tops $298 million in lifetime revenue, adding almost $98 million in just 1.5 months Publisher Perfect World recently revealed the figures in its financial report for the first half of the fiscal year.

News 2026-08-24 17:59 Shion Kaneko Perfect World has announced its financial results for the first half of 2026, revealing that the free-to-play urban RPG NTE: Neverness to Everness (hereafter NTE) has surpassed 2 billion Chinese yuan (approx. $298 million USD) in cumulative worldwide revenue.

NTE initially launched domestically on April 23, followed by its global release on April 29. Shortly after launch, Perfect World reported to investors that NTE generated more than 100 million yuan in worldwide revenue on the first day of its global release. Following the release of Version 1.1, both the Chinese and global versions set new records for highest single-day revenue on launch day. The global version was also reported to have generated more revenue than the Chinese version. Perfect World’s first-half 2026 earnings forecast subsequently revealed that revenue had surpassed 1.4 billion yuan (over $200 million USD) as of June 30.

According to the new financial report, NTE surpassed $298 million in cumulative worldwide revenue as of August 18. This means the game generated an additional $98 million over the approximately one and a half months since early July. While the pace of revenue growth has slowed, the game appears to be performing strongly even around four months after launch.

Around 60% of the total $298 in revenue came from the game’s official platforms worldwide, including the official PC and Android versions. External storefront versions, including Steam and the Epic Games Store, launched on July 8, but based on the figures disclosed, the official platforms still appear to account for a substantial share of the game’s revenue.

Despite NTE’s strong sales, Perfect World as a whole recorded a loss of around 118 million yuan or roughly $18 million USD during the first half of the fiscal year. The company cited, among other factors, a timing mismatch in revenue recognition, meaning NTE’s (rather lavish) marketing costs were recorded upfront, while player spending is recognized as revenue over a longer period.

Meanwhile, NTE’s Version 1.3, titled “Rising from the Moonlit Fog,” launched globally on August 19. The update introduces a large new map ncluding beaches, as well as new swimsuit costumes and other summer-themed content. Since the newly disclosed revenue figures do not include revenue from Version 1.3 for the global version, it will be interesting to see how this is reflected in subsequent reports.

NTE: Neverness to Everness is available as a free-to-play title on PC (official client/Steam/Epic Games Store/Google Play Games), Mac, PS5, iOS, and Android.

Related: “Each ability feels like it could have been the central mechanic of its own game.” We ask a fellow developer what makes NTE: Neverness to Everness so impressive

items.title: NTE Steam Login FAQ
items.summary: Hey, Appraisers! On \[08/19/2026], NTE will be adding Steam account login support. If you're a new player, you can simply log in with Steam to jump right into the game. If you're an existing player with game progress and want to link that t
items.content:
Hey, Appraisers!

On \[08/19/2026], NTE will be adding Steam account login support. If you're a new player, you can simply log in with Steam to jump right into the game. If you're an existing player with game progress and want to link that to your Steam account, be sure to log in to NTE using your existing game account first, and then go to \ > \ to link your Steam account.

We've also put together a list of FAQs below for your reference. If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out to Customer Support at nte.contactus@perfectworld.com.

Q: I've already logged in to NTE using my Steam account. Can I still link another game account that already has progress?

A: No. Logging in with a Steam account automatically creates a brand-new User ID, and that Steam account can't be linked to another game account with existing progress.

Q: If I play on Steam with my Steam account, can I continue playing on other platforms?

A: Yes. After you link your Steam account to an email address in the User Center, you can use that email to log in on other platforms and keep your game progress synced.

Q: My Steam account is linked to an email address / Facebook / Google. Can I unlink them later?

A: You can unlink third-party login accounts like Facebook, Google, and Steam in the User Center. Email accounts cannot be unlinked. Please proceed with care.

Q: If I unlink a Steam account from my email account, which account keeps the game progress?

A: Once the unlinking is complete, your character progress will remain with your email account.

Q: Can I link a Steam account on mobile or other clients?

A: No. Currently, only the Steam game client supports Steam account login and linking.

Q: Can an unlinked Steam account be linked to a different game account?

A: Yes. Once unlinked, your Steam account returns to an unused state and is ready to be linked to another NTE game account that isn't already linked to Steam. The process still follows the same order: log in to the target game account first, then link Steam.

items.title: Ver. 1.3 "Rising from the Moonlit Fog" Patch Notes
items.summary: Hey Appraiser, NTE will undergo version maintenance on August 19, 2026 from 06:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). Once it's done, the all-new Version 1.3 "Rising from the Moonlit Fog" goes live. "Pink Paws Heist" will be temporarily unavailable starting
items.content:
Hey Appraiser,

NTE will undergo version maintenance on August 19, 2026 from 06:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). Once it's done, the all-new Version 1.3 "Rising from the Moonlit Fog" goes live. "Pink Paws Heist" will be temporarily unavailable starting August 19 at 05:30 (UTC+8) and will reopen once maintenance wraps up.

Login will be unavailable during this period, so please plan accordingly. Since this update is on the larger side, we recommend using Wi-Fi or mobile data to complete the download. We apologize for any inconvenience!

※ "The Lifeline" Limited Board ends on August 19, 2026, at 05:59 (UTC+8). Be sure to head to the Wayfarer Perks page and redeem your rewards before then.

\

● Duration: August 19, 2026, 06:00–11:00 (UTC+8)

● Maintenance Compensation: Annulith x300

● Eligibility: Appraisers who created their character before August 19, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)

● Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance. Remember to claim the items before they expire.

※Maintenance may end earlier or later than scheduled depending on actual progress. Please keep an eye on our official announcements for updates.

● Bug Fix Compensation: Annulith x300

● Eligibility: Appraisers who created their character before August 19, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)

● Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance. Remember to claim the items before they expire.

\

PC: Close the game, reopen the launcher, and click Update.

Android: Launch the game and follow the in-game update prompt.

iOS: Download or update from the App Store.

Mac: Download or update from the App Store.

PlayStation®: Open the system menu, select NTE, press the OPTIONS button on your controller, then select Check for Update.

Steam: Close the game, exit and restart the Steam client, go to your Library, find NTE, and click Update to start the download.

Epic: Close the game, reopen the game launcher, and click Update.

Bagel Supplies

After the Version 1.3 update, Appraisers at Hunter Lvl 11 or above can claim Praise Jam x56,000 via in-game mail.

Event Duration: Permanent

Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance to Appraisers at Hunter Lvl 11 or above. Remember to claim the items before they expire.

\

1. New Character & Arc

● New Limited S-Class Character: Zankou!

Available: August 19 (after update) – September 9, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Board Details: The "Alluring Shadows" Limited Board features the limited S-Class character Zankou, along with A-Class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.

During the event, the "Alluring Shadows" Limited Board features the "Scarlet Sash" glider livery, the "Sandy Mirage" Sirocco vehicle livery, and Zankou's "Autumn Vignette" outfit. The "Alluring Perks" event opens alongside the board, so you can claim these rewards directly from the event page once you reach 50/120/200 cumulative rolls, or obtain them randomly through rolls before reaching these milestones.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.

● New Limited S-Class Arc: "Ravenous Blade"

Available: August 19 (after update) – September 9, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Research Guide: Spend Tri-Keys or Spellbound Keys to participate in the "Spellbound Special" Arc Research Program and obtain the limited S-Class Arc "Ravenous Blade". This Arc is currently only available through this program.

*For full details, head to Arc Shop › Arc Research Program in-game.

● Returning Limited S-Class Character: Nanally!

Available: August 19 (after update) – September 9, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Board Details: "The Ichi-daime" Limited Board features the limited S-Class character Nanally, along with A-Class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.

During the event, "The Ichi-daime" Limited Board features the "Underboss-of-the-Underboss" glider livery, the "Tiger Incoming!" M1000 livery, and Nanally's "Phoenix Kick" outfit. The "Tiger Perks" event opens alongside the board, so you can claim these rewards directly from the event page once you reach 50/120/200 cumulative rolls, or obtain them randomly through rolls before reaching these milestones.

※ Only rolls on "The Ichi-daime" Limited Board count toward Tiger Perks progress. Each board is tracked independently, and progress carries over between boards with the same name.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.

● Returning Limited S-Class Arc: "Ready-Ready"

Available: August 19 (after update) – September 9, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Research Guide: Spend Tri-Keys or Tiger Keys to participate in the "Tiger Special" Arc Research Program and obtain the limited S-Class Arc "Ready-Ready". This Arc is currently only available through this program.

*For full details, head to Arc Shop › Arc Research Program in-game.

2. New Story

● New Main Story Episode: "Fogden Game"

What is The Scarlet Letter plotting this time? A game?

Those left off the guest list have formed an alliance: to save, to judge, to avenge.

This time, can they finally bring Madam T down for good?

Available: After the Version 1.3 update

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story episode "Fighting with a Dragon"

● Home Time

A new Invitation mode featuring Zankou.

Available: After the Version 1.3 update

Unlock Requirement: Obtain Zankou and reach the required Bond Level.

3. New Location

● New Location: Duskmoor

Here you'll find sweeping natural scenery, the Starfall Bay Resort, and the open waters of Tearlake.

4. New Outfits & Vehicles

● New Zankou Outfit "Searing Lavender" Added to Shop

Discount Price: Riftcrystal x2,680

Original Price: Riftcrystal x3,280 (18% off, limited time)

Available: August 27, 06:30 (UTC+8)

Discount Period: August 19 (after update) – September 30, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Discount Price: Riftcrystal x1,680

Original Price: Riftcrystal x2,480 (32% off, limited time)

Shop Availability: Permanent

● New Chaos Outfit "Chartered Waves" Added to Shop

Discount Period: August 19 (after update) – September 30, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Discount Price: Riftcrystal x1,680

Original Price: Riftcrystal x2,480 (32% off, limited time)

Shop Availability: Permanent

● New Zankou Outfit "Autumn Vignette"

How to Get: While the "Alluring Shadows" Limited Board is active, roll on the board and land on the matching tile to obtain the outfit, or claim it from the Alluring Perks page once you've accumulated enough rolls.

● New Zankou Outfit "Moonlit Courtyard"

How to Get: Unlocked after you obtain Zankou and reach Bond Lvl 10.

How to Get: Unlocked after you obtain Zankou.

5. New Mystery Box Event "Lucent Tides" Goes Live

Duration: August 19, 17:00 (UTC+8) – September 30, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Spend Fons or Annulith to open "Lucent Tides" Mystery Boxes. The cost goes up with each box you open. There are 15 boxes in total, and opening all of them unlocks every reward in the pool.

Mystery Box Contents: "Lucent Tides" Mystery Boxes feature the limited watercraft "Tide", Nanally's limited outfit "Sunny Surf", Mint's limited outfit "Saltwater Taffy", Esper Zero's limited outfit "Cloudless Summer", the limited avatar frame "Endless Summer", Fabricated Dice, A Handwritten Letter, the Anomaly Pilgrimage Material Selection Box, and more.

※ The watercraft "Tide" can be summoned in ocean and lake areas.

6. New Events

● "Circle Gifts" Login Event

Duration: August 19 (after update) – September 30, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Log in for a total of 7 days to earn Solid Dice x10.

● "Volley Star" Limited-Time Event

Duration: August 19 (after update) – September 30, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Sun, sand, and volleyball! Feel the soft sand between your toes as you team up for epic spikes and game-saving dives. It's the perfect blend of athletic thrills and vacation vibes. Time to unleash your passion! Take part during the event to earn limited-time rewards like the "Summer Glow" event avatar frame, the "Imaginist Court" event namecard, Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Fons, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

● "Surf Breaker" Limited-Time Event

Duration: August 19 (after update) – September 30, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Race the sea breeze under the blazing summer sun! During the event, complete course challenges to earn rewards like Annulith, Fons, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, and Chaotic Dye.

● "Hunter's Crucible" Limited-Time Event

Duration: August 19 (after update) – September 30, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Steel is forged in fire. Hunters are forged by worthier prey. This event adds new challenge stages featuring Mammon and Morphix. During the event, clear challenge stages to rack up rewards like the "Hunter's Crucible - Steel Tempered" event title, Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Fons, Elite Hunter Guides, and Chaotic Dye.

※ The "Hunter's Crucible - Steel Tempered" title features dynamic visual effects that upgrade as you accumulate event points.

● "Shipwreck Salvage" Limited-Time Event

Duration: August 28, 10:00 – September 30, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Just another day of picking up bottles. During the event, take part to earn the event currency "Drifting Bottle", then trade it in at the event shop for rewards like the "Full Haul" event avatar frame, the "Treasure Hunt" event namecard, Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Fons, and more.

● "Stamina Recharge" Limited-Time Event

Duration: August 24, 05:00 – August 31, 04:59 (server time)

Details: During the event, City Stamina is consumed at 2x efficiency in "Hethereau Hobbies" activities.

● "Gold Clash" Limited-Time Event

Duration: August 31, 05:00 – September 14, 04:59 (server time)

Details: During the event, earn Fons at 2x efficiency in "Pink Paws Heist".

7. Other Content

● Version 1.3 "Circle Bounty" Guide

Available: August 19 (after update) – September 30, 23:59 (UTC+8)

Requirement: Complete the Main Quest "Relax Time"

Details: During the event, take on Circle Quests to earn Experience Points, raise your Circle Bounty Rank, and claim rewards like Fabricated Dice, Gold Carrota, De-noise Solution, A Handwritten Letter, and Expansion Cores.

Purchase Elite Hunter Supplies to unlock extra rewards as you rank up, including Annulith x680, Solid Dice x4, Fabricated Dice x2, Arc-light Trove x1, A Handwritten Letter x2, and Fons x700,000!

Purchase this season's Honor Hunter Supplies to unlock all of the above rewards, plus the "de Xiaozhen" avatar, the "Bountiful Garden" avatar frame, the "Splash Showdown" namecard, Fabricated Dice x5, A Handwritten Letter x1, and Fons x500,000!

\

◆ New Duskmoor Anomaly Commissions: Twin Blooms, Lantern Parade, Storybook Skirmish, Finale: Da Capo, Fawn Alone, and Sunken Door

◆ New routes in "Races - Challenge": Night Raptor, Chapter Nova, First Sense, Silver Crown

◆ New scratchers are now available at "The Midnight" Catzebo. Fons won from the new scratchers no longer counts toward Tycoon Level or the Pawbes Rich List. (*After the update, the "Beyond the Screen", "Hethereau Daily", "What Do Cats Dream Of?", "The Art of Ramen", and "Beyond the Book" scratchers will be removed from sale.)

◆ Adjusted the "Tycoon Incentive Fund" earnings rules: the 1,000,000 Fons reward pool that "Pink Paws Heist" paid out each cycle is now the "Tycoon Incentive Fund". Earnings from the "Weekly Match" mode in "Volley Star" and passive income from Collectibles Warehouse display cases in "Going, Going, Gone!" also draw from the "Tycoon Incentive Fund" allowance.

◆ Added the new "Gauntlet of Valor" mode to "999 Nights". Head to the Warren Continent to try it out.

◆ Added a new Hethereau Hobbies activity: "Volley Star"

◆ Added a new Hethereau Hobbies activity: "Going, Going, Gone!"

◆ Added a new Hethereau Hobbies activity: "Shadow-n-Seek". Each round of "Shadow-n-Seek" now costs City Stamina.

◆ Added an "Outfit Rotation" feature: when enabled, a random outfit you own is selected and equipped from that character's wardrobe each time you log in or change scenes.

◆ Adjusted and improved "Going, Going, Gone!": Added seasonal Profit and Wealth Leaderboards, along with matching seasonal quests and rewards; added a venue conditions mechanic; added an in-match quick chat system with preset phrases; added 20 brand-new collectibles and improved the collectible spawn algorithm; adjusted collectible spawn rates across sessions and slightly increased the spawn rate of "Eternal Heart".

◆ Added Bond quests for Zankou.

◆ Added new Bond interactions for Zankou: reach the required Bond Level to unlock her passenger seat ride-along.

◆ Added a combat tutorial for Zankou.

◆ Raised "The Witch's House" level cap to 15.

◆ "Bronze Carrota" and "Silver Carrota" can now be crafted into higher-tier Carrota.

◆ Some items can now be discarded: use the button in the bottom-left corner of the Inventory screen and select the items you want to discard. (*Items that can be discarded include Manhole Boss, Paradoxical Whispers, Chaos Silhouette, Distorted Numeral, and Transcendent Delusions.)

◆ Streamlined the upgrade flow for Characters, Arcs, Consoles, and Modules, and improved the guidance for acquiring the items you need to Ascend when you don't have enough.

◆ Added a "Claim All" button to the Anomaly Furniture Effects screen. You can now collect daily Anomaly Furniture rewards across all your properties with a single click.

◆ Added a glasses accessory to Nanally's "The Popular Kid" outfit.

◆ Added tag categories for posts on Bagel SNS.

◆ Added a confirmation popup when gifting "A Handwritten Letter".

◆ Added a minimap to "Pink Paws Heist".

◆ Added "Shadow Sweep" tracking in multiplayer.

◆ Added passenger orders for new locations to "Swift Cab" and updated the voice lines for unhappy passengers.

◆ Added delivery orders for new locations to "City Delivery".

◆ "City Delivery" now supports Auto-Drive.

◆ Added multiple new racetracks to "Races - Online".

◆ Added a quick-lock feature to the "Sea Angler" fish tank screen.

◆ On the "Sea Angler" catch results screen, you can now press F to jump straight back into fishing.

◆ Photo Mode can now be used while driving or swimming.

◆ Added the F7 shortcut key to hide in-game UI with a single press (currently PC only).

◆ Improved City Tycoon Lvl 16 Perk: City Stamina consumption speed increased from 100% to 200%.

◆ Farm produce can now be sold by spending City Stamina. You can grow crops by farming at "Stillmeadow House".

◆ Added an aim assist toggle under Settings - Control.

◆ Shinku can now perform interactions while in "Surging Crimson" or the hold-dodge special movement state, which instantly ends her transformed state.

◆ Improved the visual effects for Chaos's dodge.

◆ Improved the visuals of Shinku's 5th Basic Attack hit when the target is off-balance.

◆ In "999 Nights", the maximum amount of gear that can be recycled at once has been raised to 50.

◆ Various quality-of-life improvements to "999 Nights".

◆ Improved character rendering.

◆ Character info can now be shared on Bagel SNS.

◆ Fixed an issue where recolored outfits did not display correctly on passenger-seat companions and characters hired at "The Cafe by Origen".

◆ Fixed an issue where Shinku's wall climbing animations could play incorrectly while she's in the hold-dodge special movement state.

◆ Fixed an issue where Jiuyuan's animations could play incorrectly when leaving the battlefield after being hit.

◆ Fixed an issue where Shinku's "Instant Strike" could drop damage against multiple targets while "Snowfall Slope" was active.

◆ Fixed an issue where Shinku's stamina could drain at abnormal rates in certain cases when entering the hold-dodge special movement state.

◆ Fixed an issue where Hotori did not gain "Defiant Spirit" when spending stacks of "Menacing Gaze" while recording and replaying Shinku's Skills.

◆ Fixed an issue in the Bagel notification settings screen where pressing \ caused other settings to display incorrectly.

◆ Fixed an issue on some mobile devices, where vehicle controls could not be customized.

◆ Fixed an issue in controller mode where the Term Notes screen for character Esper Abilities could not scroll.

◆ Fixed crashes that could occur in certain situations.

◆ Improved localization for several languages.

◆ Fixed other known issues.

Perfect World Games and Hotta Studio have detailed Version 1.3 for the supernatural urban open-world RPG Neverness to Everness , titled " Rising from the Moonlit Fog ." The update was revealed during an August 8 preview livestream and launches globally on August 19, 2026, bringing a story conclusion, two new areas, two new S-Class characters, and a summer event lineup.

The centerpiece of Version 1.3 is a new story chapter, also titled Rising from the Moonlit Fog , that closes out the Scarlet Letter arc, picking up from where Version 1.1's Corridor of Echoes left off. The chapter takes players into Fogden, an ever-shifting domain built to simulate a scenario devised by the Scarlet Letter faction, and Duskmoor, a forest-themed zone centered on driving routes and a launch ramp for aerial stunts. The update also adds a new Location Anomaly tied to the expanded map.

Version 1.3 introduces two new S-Class characters. Zankou, an Incantation-type Gas Esper aligned with the Scarlet Letter faction, headlines the first banner phase, running from August 19 to September 9. Linko, an Anima-type Plasma Esper built around synchronizing team attacks, follows in the second phase, from September 9 to September 30. Each phase lasts 21 days, matching the game's usual banner cadence.

Alongside the story and character content, Version 1.3 adds a summer event built around new minigames, including Volley Star, Surf Breaker, and Shipwreck Salvage, plus a new jet ski called The Tide. Players can also purchase a new property, Stillmeadow House, using the in-game currency Fons, which introduces a crop-growing mechanic that consumes City Stamina in exchange for sellable produce. New outfits arrive for Zankou and Linko, alongside a set of summer-themed swimsuits for other characters.

items.title: Neverness to Everness players find AI watermark left on Version 1.3 in-game artwork
items.summary: Chinese players found an unexpectedly familiar logo hiding in one of Version 1.3's assets.
items.content:
All News An AI logo was found in one of NTE's assets (image: Hotta Studios).

{" "} Neverness to Everness players find AI watermark left on Version 1.3 in-game artwork .iframe-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .img-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .a-img-media {aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} Chinese players found an unexpectedly familiar logo hiding in one of Version 1.3's assets. Neverness to Everness is facing another round of criticism over its use of generative AI after Chinese players spotted a Doubao watermark left on an in-game image. The artwork, which depicts a seahorse, appeared in Version 1.3 of the supernatural open-world RPG following its release in China on 12 August. Screenshots quickly began circulating among Chinese players before making their way to Reddit and X , with one detail making the source of the image particularly hard to miss: a visible watermark for ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao.

Doubao (豆包) is a generative AI assistant developed by TikTok parent company ByteDance, with tools covering text, image, and video generation, among other functions. Images and videos generated through its free tier carry a visible watermark.

Platforms : PC, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, iOS, Android, and Mac

Bilibili creator Wuxiang Xiaoyugan (五香小鱼干) was among the Chinese players who checked the image themselves, uploading a video showing the seahorse artwork in-game on 17 August. In the video, Wuxiang Xiaoyugan says they initially saw the image shared in a group chat and thought it looked AI-generated. They then logged into NTE to check and found the same asset, complete with the Doubao watermark.

A separate Bilibili discussion captured some of the Chinese player reactions, with screenshots of the comments later shared on X.

User Daidai Damowang (带带大魔王) confirmed they had checked the asset themselves: “I just logged in and checked, and it's real.”

Once that was settled, the comments quickly turned to what else Doubao might have been used for behind the scenes. Xuanyuan Xiaopangzhi (轩辕小胖纸) joked that “the code was probably written directly by Doubao,” while Heiyu Yemao (黑羽夜猫) imagined the request behind the seahorse itself: “Doubao, Doubao, help me generate a game asset image of a Purple-crowned Seahorse.”

Then Xuezhixia Xuenaide Mao (雪之下雪乃的猫) decided to skip a few steps and ask for the whole game: “Doubao, Doubao, can you help me generate an open-world anime-style game? Remove the watermark.” The jokes continued from there, with players wondering how many tokens it would take to generate an entire game and taking shots at NTE's development costs.

Back on the original Bilibili video, Wuxiang Xiaoyugan returned with an update the following day. “The official version has already been updated, and the Doubao watermark issue has been fixed,” the creator wrote on 18 August.

NTE has faced questions over its use of generative AI before. Shortly after its April launch, players flagged several suspected AI-generated assets , while VTuber Ironmouse pulled out of sponsored content for the game over AI concerns .

Hotta Studio later acknowledged using AI-assisted tools on “a small number of background and environmental assets”, while saying that the characters, stories, and world in NTE were the work of its artists, writers, and designers. The studio also said it was reworking flagged assets and was “committed to delivering the quality you deserve.” However, Hotta has not commented on the latest controversy.

items.summary: The brand-new auction mini-game "Going, Going, Gone!" is now available. Your goal: build a fortune on sharp, savvy calls. The Treasure Ship Auction starts now! Event Duration July 29 (after update) – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8) Event Rules 1.
items.content:
The brand-new auction mini-game "Going, Going, Gone!" is now available. Your goal: build a fortune on sharp, savvy calls. The Treasure Ship Auction starts now!

Event Duration

July 29 (after update) – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Event Rules

1. This mode uses a special auction currency: Gold Shells.

2. Before entering an auction, you can freely choose your Auction Assistant and Device Set. There are 3 auction tiers, each with different lots and entry requirements.

3. After the auction begins, you will have 5 rounds to place bids. In each round, estimate the total value of the lots within the time limit and submit your bid. Your selected Auction Assistant and items can provide intel to help you appraise the lots.

4. If you meet one of the following conditions, you can immediately win all current lots and end the auction:

- Round 1: Bid more than 2× the 2nd-highest bid.

- Round 2: Bid more than 1.6× the 2nd-highest bid.

- Round 3: Bid more than 1.3× the 2nd-highest bid.

- Round 4: Bid more than 1.1× the 2nd-highest bid.

- Round 5: The highest bidder wins all lots.

5. If players are tied in Round 5, the auction enters Round 6. Only the players tied in Round 5 may bid again, and the highest bidder wins all lots. If players are tied again in Round 6, the auction ends with no sale.

6. If the winning bidder ends the settlement phase at a loss, each of the other three players receives a bonus equal to 10% of the loss.

7. Any collectibles you win are automatically added to your Collection. You can either sell them or put them on display. Displayed collectibles generate income over time.

Event Rewards

Complete event quests and fill out your Item Index to earn the "Highest Bidder Wins" title, the "Choice" avatar frame, the "Deal!" namecard, Annulith, Fons, and more.

items.title: Shadow-n-Seek: Gameplay Guide
items.summary: The all-new asymmetric PvP mode Shadow-n-Seek is now live! During each match, you'll be randomly assigned to the Hider or Hunter side for a tense, thrilling showdown of disguise and pursuit. Duration July 17, 10:00 - August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8
items.content:
The all-new asymmetric PvP mode Shadow-n-Seek is now live! During each match, you'll be randomly assigned to the Hider or Hunter side for a tense, thrilling showdown of disguise and pursuit.

Duration

July 17, 10:00 - August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)

The Two Sides

🎭 Hider: When the match begins, you get a prep window to explore the map and pick one of three items to disguise yourself. Once transformed, you look just like an ordinary object in the scene, making you tough for Hunters to spot! You can't attack while hidden, so rely on moving, repositioning, and planting decoys to stay out of the Hunters' hands.

🔍 Hunter: You have 2 minutes and 20 seconds to track down and catch every Hider! Hunters have a scanning ability; land a hit on a Hider to trigger the catch. But be careful: swing at the wrong target and the backlash costs you HP, so look closely before you strike!

Win Conditions

Hiders win: at least 2 Hiders are still alive when the timer runs out, or all Hunters' HP is depleted.

Hunters win: catch every Hider before time runs out.

Event Rewards

Take part in the event to earn the event currency "Paper Cup Phone", then visit the Shadebound Shop to redeem rewards like the "Gotcha!" avatar frame, Annulith, Floe Cinema Ticket, and Fons.
